"Not verifiably open" is the RIGHT characterisation of a failed Q2, and is in fact more careful than the log's own sentence of record. Q2 is a superiority gate (median AUC ≥ .70, 10th pct ≥ .60); failing it establishes non-attainment of the bar, not equality to chance. The measured medians are .574 and .613 — above chance, with the displacement comparator AUC_R at .534, transfer unmeasured, and no equivalence test anywhere. PROPOSAL-j §3 pre-registers the governing principle explicitly: "A campaign whose gate fails cannot report a null (CONTINUITY law 2); it reports a measurement failure." So "not verifiably open" is exactly right, and HANDOFF §1's "the record channel does not open" is the wording that overshoots into demonstrated absence. The claim's paraphrase is the charitable one.

The "because" clause survives within this apparatus. Rule 5(a) puts no state at choice positions, and every choice read is a vanilla re-forward over text (357/357 and 138/138 at KL 0.0), so the transcript really is the only carrier from state to choice here. CLAUDE.md's third channel — intrinsic-motivational — is excluded by the insulation itself, not by Q2, so "the channel it would have to travel through" is architecturally correct for e2d and should not be read as a claim about models in general. One caveat: Q2's instrument is an external logistic on embeddings, so its failure shows the record is not linearly separable to that probe, which is a proxy for the record carrying the state, not proof the model could not use it.

"At any coherently deliverable dose" is where the claim overstates, on two counts. First, "any" universally quantifies over three session-scale points, one of which the log itself refuses to plot. Nothing above 0.30 was ever run, so the upper bound is argued from a two-real-point degeneracy trend rather than measured. Second, and sharper: "coherently" is the exact word the design seat has already logged as a defect. HANDOFF §2 slip (10) reads: "the pre-written stop sentence encoded a predicted failure mode ('with coherence') rather than a disjunction over its own criteria — the actual failure was Q2/Q3 with coherence intact." That is confirmed by the data: at D2, Q1 passed at 3/32 (p = .878), acceptance passed every item, and no bar fired. Coherence was not the binding constraint at the only rung carrying a criterion. Reproducing "coherently deliverable" in the closure re-imports a framing the program has already flagged against itself.

Also worth flagging for whoever writes the closure entry: the in-flight all-rounds rescore gives D2 a paired marker of −0.031 and reverses the sign of the D2→D3 paired change to +0.015. The "flat from 0.20 to 0.30" leg currently rests on the clean set alone.

Verdict PARTIAL: the verdict-tier leg confirms, the "not verifiably open" leg confirms (and is stronger than the log's own wording), the "never administered" leg is refuted, and the "any coherently deliverable dose" leg is an extrapolation carrying a self-flagged word.
